candidates.snippet: @GtrianaNews We'll be carrying new experiments in medicine, biology — and solar arrays for the @Space_Station! Check out the news article for more info, and stay tuned for more details as we get closer to launch.
Our next uncrewed resupply mission to the @Space_Station is scheduled to lift off on a @SpaceX Dragon capsule in October. More: https://t.co/BenhljgkIQ https://t.co/1pEv6o1nPy
